en.headline: Eight arrested as police raid baccarat den on Lai Chi Kok Road
en.dek: Mong Kok officers seized a baccarat table, about HK$20,000 in cash and chips worth about HK$220,000 in an operation codenamed Fullboom.
body: Mong Kok district special duties officers raided a flat on Lai Chi Kok Road on Thursday and arrested eight people over a suspected illegal baccarat den, police said.

The operation, codenamed Fullboom, followed what police described as an investigation and intelligence analysis. Officers who entered the unit found people they believed were gambling at baccarat and took control of everyone inside. They seized a baccarat table, about HK$20,000 in suspected betting cash, chips with a face value of about HK$220,000 and other gambling equipment.

A 61-year-old local woman was arrested on suspicion of managing a gambling establishment. A 27-year-old local woman was arrested on suspicion of assisting in the management of a gambling establishment. A local man, a mainland man and four local women, aged between 30 and 77, were arrested on suspicion of gambling in a gambling establishment. All eight were being detained.

Police said they were still tracing how long the den had operated, where the money went and whether others were involved. Under the Gambling Ordinance, managing a gambling establishment carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and seven years' imprisonment. Gambling in such a place carries a maximum fine of HK$30,000 and nine months' jail on a first conviction.

zh.headline: 荔枝角道搗百家樂賭檔 8人被捕檢22萬簫碼
zh.dek: 旺角警區特別職務隊行動代號「蓄勢」，在荔枝角道單位檢獲百家樂賭柯、約2萬元現金及面值約22萬元簫碼。
body: 警方表示，旺角警區特別職務隊週四展開代號「蓄勢」的反賭博行動，突擊搜查荔枝角道一個單位，搗破一個懸疑非法百家樂賭檔，共拘捕8人。
警員進入單位後，發現有人懸疑正在進行百家樂賭博，即場控制場內各人。行動中檢獲一張百家樂賭柯、約2萬元懸疑賭款、面值約22萬元簫碼，以及一批賭具。
一名61歲本地女子涉嫌管理賭博場所被捕，另一名27歲本地女子涉嫌協助管理賭博場所被捕。單位內另外一名本地男子、一名內地男子及4名本地女子，年齡介乎30至77歲，涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。8人現正被扣留調查。
警方正追查賭檔營運時間、資金流向及是否涉及其他人。根據《賭博條例》，管理賭博場所最高可判罰款500萬元及監禁7年；在賭博場所內賭博，首次定罪最高可判罰款3萬元及監禁9個月。
